 'gompT': (lambda p: p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*t)) + p[3]*A**3*np.exp(-p[4]*t) + p[5]*t, [6,2,0.5,0.17,0.09,0.0]),
 'powsat': (lambda p: p[0]*(1-np.exp(-p[1]*t))**p[2] + p[3]*A**3*np.exp(-p[4]*t)+p[5], [6,0.5,1,0.17,0.09,0.0]),
 'logist': (lambda p: p[0]/(1+p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*t)) + p[3]*A**3*np.exp(-p[4]*t)+p[5]*t, [6,2,0.5,0.17,0.09,0.0]),
 'sinsat': (lambda p: p[0]-p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*t)+p[3]*np.sin(p[4]*t+p[5])+p[6]*A**3*np.exp(-p[7]*t), [4,2,0.5,0.5,0.3,0.0,0.17,0.09]),
}
for nm,(f,p0) in G.items():
    best=None
    for sc in [1.0,0.7,1.4]:
